avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate immune activation and increase risk of immune-related adverse events (irAEs) in patients receiving PD-1 inhibitors
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on immune stimulant risks

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune-stimulating properties may enhance PD-1 checkpoint inhibition, elevating autoimmune toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under close clinical monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: Curcumin (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune activation and increase inflammatory response in patients on checkpoint inhibitors
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to dietary amounts; avoid supplemental doses

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Gut microbiota composition may influence immunotherapy efficacy; effects are individual-dependent
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; standardized strains may be preferable

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Immune modulatory effects; deficiency associated with altered checkpoint inhibitor response in some studies
caution_supplements.action: Maintain adequate levels (25-75 ng/mL); monitor if supplementing

caution_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate hypertension, a known irAE in PD-1 inhibitor therapy
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderation; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: May impair immune function and increase hepatotoxicity risk during immunotherapy
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate intake; assess baseline liver function

monitoring_notes: Cemiplimab is not hepatically metabolized, thus drug-drug interactions are minimal. Primary concern is immune potentiation from supplements that may increase irAE risk. Monitor for immune-related adverse events (colitis, pneumonitis, hepatitis, endocrinopathies) and counsel patients to avoid immunostimulatory supplements.
